name: Camp Horizon
operator_name: Village of Briarcliff Manor Recreation Department
description_short: Village trip camp for teens entering 7th to 9th grade who live in Briarcliff Manor or its school district, with a trip every day to amusement parks, adventure courses and arcades. Drop off at the Law Park Pavilion and pick up at the Youth Center.
notes: Prices shown are the school district resident rate; village residents pay $420 for week 1, $1,060 a session and $2,540 for all five weeks.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Camp Horizon sheet: for children of Briarcliff residents and Briarcliff school district residents entering 7th to 9th grade; Monday to Friday from 8:45 with varying pick up times; trips every day. Fees resident / school district: 5 week bundle $2,540 / $3,150, Session 1 or 2 $1,060 / $1,325, Week 1 add-on $420 / $525. Session prices are the school district rate. Ages derived from grades. Indoor and outdoor inferred from the mix of trips.
Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Day Camp FAQ: Camp Horizon is one of the department's four camps; refund policy.
Researched by Claude from this page. Village home page footer: Village Office, 1111 Pleasantville Road, Briarcliff Manor, NY 10510. The camp sheet gives no ZIP.

changes: Town added to cities.py from the Census 2024 Gazetteer, so the city validates.
for_andrew: Only Briarcliff Manor village residents and school district residents (who pay a higher rate, recorded here) can enroll; nobody else. Andrew's rule for residents only camps: record the one rate, say who can enroll, and ask. List it?

refund_policy_summary: If you register, you have about two weeks to cancel for a full refund less a processing fee and about a month for a 50% refund; after early March refunds are only for limited, documented reasons. (The FAQ says this policy was awaiting board approval when printed.)
